cases.message: @pattern on a concept field takes one string
property "slug": invalid @pattern "^[a-z": error parsing regexp: missing closing ]
cases.note: A concept field's pattern is compiled at load, as an args field's is (cells/argsField/pattern): it reaches the schema as the JSON-Schema pattern keyword, which is compiled on the concept's first write, so an invalid expression used to load and then refuse every write to the concept (memql#5426).
